eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Washington; at 1:38 PM on AUG 24, 2026 Effective until 2:38 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Washington State Patrol on behalf of the Wenatchee Police Department has issued an Amber Alert. Victim is a 1-year-old Male named Eirick Sailema. He is in the company of Stephanie Gifford, a 41-year-old Female, who is 5-Foot 7-Inches, weighing 225 pounds with Brown Hair, Blue Eyes.  They may be traveling in a Dark Gray 2006 Acura TSX.  Washington License B Y J 5 7 5 2. If you have information, please call 9 1 1.
